conviction_note: Lean slightly up. Customer counterparties that reported after ASML last spoke (Samsung's record Q3 preliminary profit, TSMC's record Q3 revenue, Micron raising capex) all point to strong 2027 demand. ASML's own July capacity plan (+30% units, about +45% effective EUV output) sits above the roughly 28% 2027 sales growth consensus. Calls are bid (skew -7.1). But the real reaction history sells beats: 2 of 6 confirmed prints up, and the July beat-and-raise faded from +7.8% to +2.2%. So p_up is 55 on a 6.0% absolute move (the 5.1% event-implied move, raised because this release is the first 2027 framing). That gives +0.6, against a findings sum of +1.6. The gap is deliberate: the findings are each sized alone, and the scaled number carries the beat-selling history.
bar: Q3 2026 net sales. Company guide is EUR 11.0-12.0bn with GM 55-57% (https://investor.asml.com/news-releases/news-release-details/q2-2026-financial-results, 2026-07-15). Consensus is about EUR 11.6-11.85bn in two previews (https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262211059-asml-q3-earnings-preview-revenue-tradingkey and https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/asml-stock-q3-earnings-preview, both around 2026-10-12). The two sources roughly agree, so the bar is sourced. 24/7 Wall St's USD consensus of $11.68B is inconsistent with that once FX is applied, so it is set aside. The 2027 line is the real bar: Bloomberg consensus is about +28% 2027 sales growth per JPMorgan (https://www.themarketreporter.co.uk/a/45352134/jp-morgan-expects-asml-to-signal-strong-2027-demand-as-stock-trades-at-u, about 2026-10-07).
positioning_check: Short interest is about 0.33% of float with about 1 day to cover (Benzinga, 2026-06-30 settlement, https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/ASML/short-interest, per the sweep row), so it is not crowded. Skew is -7.09 vol points: calls are bid and the market leans up. Put/call OI is 1.15. Seeking Alpha/TradingView's Oct 16 weekly chain shows puts stacked at $1,400-1,500 and calls at $1,900-2,000, with the straddle at about 5.5% (https://www.tradingview.com/news/seekingalpha:d569eda65094b:0-asml-options-traders-build-deep-downside-defenses-ahead-of-earnings/, 2026-10-13). The stock is -7.4% over 5 days, which is sector de-risking, not crowding.

findings.finding: Counterparties that reported after ASML's 15 July call all printed records. Samsung's Q3 2026 preliminary operating profit was KRW 107.4tn, driven mainly by memory (2026-10-08). TSMC's Q3 revenue was a record NT$1.494tn, +50.9% y/y (2026-10-08). Micron raised its FY27 capex (late Sept 2026). This supports a strong 2027 EUV/DRAM framing on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ASML trades on the forward framing. In July 2026 a beat and raise with a near-fully-booked 2027 spiked +7.8% intraday and closed +2.2%. In Jan 2026, record Q4 bookings closed -2.2% (marketbeat 2026-01-28).
findings.why_not_priced: Customer prints are public, and the stock ran toward $2,000 around Oct 6 partly on them. It then fell 7.4% in 5 sessions on CXMT and AI-funding fears, not on any customer weakening. If the market had held the customer strength, ASML would not have given back the run while its customers posted records. This is partly priced, so it is sized small as a counterparty proxy.
findings.independence: TSMC September/Q3 revenue release, a different company and different document: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3343 (2026-10-08). Micron FQ4 capex raise: https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/mu-stock-drops-after-hours-micron-s-heightened-capex-forecast-overpowers-q4-beat-expectation-beating-q1-guidance/cZMFVZfRBLS. These are proxies, not ASML numbers.

findings.finding: ASML reportedly raises the price of all EUV and DUV replacement parts to Korean customers by a flat 10% from January 2027 deliveries, and Samsung and SK hynix reportedly accepted. This is a pricing-power and 2027 installed-base margin signal. The source is The Elec, carried by several outlets, with no ASML confirmation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Installed-base upside drove the Q2 2026 beat (IBM EUR 2.8bn, EUR 300m above guide) and the stock closed +2.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is widely reported (Oct 9-12), and the stock fell after it, so most of it is in the price. The only unpriced part is whether management quantifies the 2027 installed-base margin on the call. The item is small relative to the EUR 11bn+ quarterly sales base.
findings.independence: Same single origin (The Elec), relayed at https://xenospectrum.com/en/asml-korea-spare-parts-price-hike/. A separate July TrendForce report on 10% higher prices for mature DUV tools: https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/07/16/news-asml-reportedly-seeks-higher-tool-prices-as-tsmc-pushes-back-mature-duv-tools-could-see-10-hike/

findings.finding: Q3 sales consensus of about EUR 11.6-11.85bn already sits in the upper half of the EUR 11.0-12.0bn guide. ASML beat the high end of its Q2 guide on installed-base upgrades, and 24/7 Wall St counts 11-0 upward revisions in 30 days, so a landing near the top of the range is likely. That result is inside what was guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Of the confirmed prints, Q2 2026 (above the guide's high end) closed +2.2%. Q1 2026 closed -2.4% and Q4 2025 -2.2%. The quarter itself has not paid.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced. Consensus already sits above the guide midpoint, and the result lands inside the company's own range, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Revisions count and consensus from https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/12/why-october-14-could-change-everything-for-asml-stock/ (2026-10-12). The Q2 beat over the high end is from ASML's own release, https://investor.asml.com/news-releases/news-release-details/q2-2026-financial-results

findings.finding: The -7.4% over 5 sessions into the print is sector de-risking on CXMT's server-DRAM/4F2 claim and AI-financing fears, not ASML news. Investing.com calls it pre-earnings positioning 'rather than any deterioration' in fundamentals, while calls stay bid (skew -7.1).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 27 July China-DUV drop (about -7 to -8.5%), the stock recovered toward $2,000 by early October. That shows sector scares have retraced, but not inside one session.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown is itself the price. The claim is only that it lowers the bar for the forward framing. If the sector fear were company-relevant, analysts would be cutting 2027 estimates; instead JPM and BofA raised targets in early October.
findings.independence: Invezz 2026-10-13 attributes the move to CXMT and AI funding, with an analyst calling it disproportionate: https://invezz.com/ng/news/2026/10/13/asml-european-chip-stocks-fall-on-cxmt-threat-and-ai-funding-fears/

findings.finding: ASML's own July plan puts 2027 low-NA EUV capacity up 30% from about 65 units, with effective output closer to +45% on NXE:3800E/F mix per the CFO, and immersion up 30%, with 2027 low-NA EUV 'close to fully covered with orders'. That arithmetic sits above the roughly +28% 2027 sales-growth consensus that JPMorgan cites. JPMorgan expects ASML to give initial 2027 guidance with Q3, as it did in the last two Octobers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025, the first 2026 framing ('not below 2025'), closed +2.7%. Jul 2025, when 2026 growth could not be confirmed, closed -8.3%. Jul 2026, with 2027 capacity +30%, closed +2.2% after +7.8% intraday.
findings.why_not_priced: The capacity numbers are public, but consensus sits at about +28% growth, below what +30% units and +45% effective EUV output at higher ASPs would imply. If the market had priced the capacity arithmetic, consensus would be in the mid-30s and the stock would not trade at a forward P/E JPM calls a downturn multiple. The risk is management conservatism: the CEO said in July that 2027 demand had not reached a 'stable state'.
findings.independence: JPMorgan note, a different document: https://www.themarketreporter.co.uk/a/45352134/jp-morgan-expects-asml-to-signal-strong-2027-demand-as-stock-trades-at-u (about 2026-10-07). The CFO's 45% effective-output remark is in the call transcript, https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/15/asml-asml-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/ (same event as the source).

findings.finding: China was about 20% of 2026 sales, mainly mainstream logic (CFO, July). In late July a state-backed Chinese consortium was reported to have begun mass-producing immersion DUV tools, with SMIC, Hua Hong and CXMT as early customers. A 2027 framing that flags China normalising lower is a risk to the DUV line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 27 July 2026 China-DUV headline cost about 7-8.5% in a session. China comments have moved prints before (the Oct 2024 guide cut).
findings.why_not_priced: A China decline in 2027 is widely expected and was hit hard in July, so it is mostly priced. The sizing is net of the other 80% of sales, which customers say is booming. Short interest of 0.33% does not argue for shrinking further, but the call-bid skew does.
findings.independence: https://aiweekly.co/alerts/asml-sinks-7-as-china-begins-homegrown-duv-machine-output. The date of about 2026-07-27 comes from the search summary and was not confirmed in the URL path.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the call-bid skew (-7.1, upside paid) and cuts against the -7.4% 5-day run-down, which reads as sector de-risking rather than company news. The rebuilt reaction history (2 of 6 confirmed prints up, beats sold) is what holds p_up at 55.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (proxy, counterparty not company): customer-record finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7.

Rule 1 plus the FPI-history note: reaction history rebuilt from confirmed prints only (dropping 2026-04-23 and 2026-02-25), giving 2 of 6 up with beats sold. p_up moved 57 to 55 and the capacity/guidance finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6.
Rule 6 (inside the guided range): Q3 sales finding cut from +0.3 to +0.1.
Rule 2/6 (already-reported, single-source parts price hike): cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Rule 5/7 (a drawdown explained by sector news is not company evidence; positioning is the bar): positioning finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Rules 7 and 9 (negative against a call-bid skew, net of the 80% non-China book): China finding cut from -0.4 to -0.3. Short interest of 0.33% checked, not crowded.
Left standing: abs_move_pct 6.0, the bar, and every sign.
